verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents an extensible `ros2` command-line suite for introspecting nodes, topics, and services, backed by a graph daemon, plus built-in topic statistics, service introspection, parameter get/set, bag recording and RViz. Community users single out the CLI tools, viewers and bags as practical benefits. However, the evidence never documents remote inspection of a deployed robot or inspection of logs; remote access is only implied by the networked DDS middleware and QoS settings for non-ideal networks. Missing for 10: explicit docs on remote/multi-machine introspection of a deployed robot, log inspection tooling (e.g., log streaming/viewing), independent hands-on corroboration of remote debugging workflows.
